{{Top|leg}}
The '''North Market''' was a marketplace located on the north side of [[Iritsa]]. It was frequented by [[Clog-dweller]]s and featured many dining and drinking establishments. It was also a popular hangout spot for many of [[Hahz Fallone]]'s guards.
